verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to export account data, such as fine-tuned model weights, uploaded datasets, batch outputs, or usage history, in open formats. OpenAI-compatible APIs and open-source models lower code-level lock-in, but they say nothing about exporting your data. Data export is a fair question for an inference and fine-tuning platform, so the verdict is "none" rather than "na".
